# Debris Removal Insurance

> Debris Removal Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for debris removal and junk hauling contractors in all 50 states. Coverage lines: dump truck insurance, general liability for junk removal, commercial auto for debris haulers, workers' compensation for hauling crews, roll-off truck and dumpster insurance, pollution and environmental liability for demolition debris, tools and equipment (inland marine), and commercial umbrella. A-rated specialty trucking and contractor carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [Dump Truck Insurance](/services/dump-truck-insurance): The defining hauling risk — commercial auto liability, physical damage, cargo, and MCS-90 filings for dump truck operators.
- [General Liability Insurance](/services/general-liability): Premises, jobsite, and completed-operations coverage for junk removal and debris hauling.
- [Commercial Auto Insurance](/services/commercial-auto): Junk removal trucks, roll-offs, and support vehicles — including cargo coverage.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): Heavy-lifting, loading, and equipment injuries with proper hauling class codes.
- [Roll-Off Truck & Dumpster Insurance](/services/roll-off-truck-insurance): Trucks, containers, and the on-site liability that follows a roll-off box.
- [Pollution & Environmental Liability](/services/pollution-liability): Demolition debris, asbestos, contaminated soil, and regulated loads.
- [Tools, Equipment & Inland Marine](/services/tools-equipment): Loaders, trailers, roll-off containers, and gear that moves between jobsites.
- [Commercial Umbrella Insurance](/services/umbrella): Excess liability above auto, GL, and employers' liability.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **debris removal and junk hauling contractors** (dump trucks, roll-offs, junk haulers, storm-debris crews) — not generic business-owner coverage.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated specialty trucking and contractor markets (A+ where possible).
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries 20 niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
